svg.aria-label: Meet the ten Hydra heads. Each head stands on the part of a code editor it works on: file tree, editor, terminal, tests, git, docs, import graph and config. One at a time each head is spotlighted on a turntable beside a card with its name, role, tier, ability, how to invoke it and a short demo. Seven run on the cheap tier and three on the mid tier.
svg.title: Meet the ten heads

g.text: Seven cheap-tier, three mid-tier. Your main model orchestrates.
